chinese: 这里有一个乒乓球拍，是你的吗？
english: There is a ping-pong bat here. Is it yours?

chinese: 不，不是我的。是埃拉的吗？
english: No, it isn’t mine. Is it Ella’s?

chinese: 嗨，雅明！这是你的拍子吗？
english: Hi, Yaming! Is this your bat?

chinese: 不客气。你的拍子看起来很旧了。你经常打吗？
english: Not at all. Your bat looks well-used. Do you play often?

chinese: 是的，一周两次，有时候更多！你呢？
english: Yes, twice a week, and sometimes more! And you?

chinese: 几乎从不。我打得不太好！
english: Hardly ever. I’m not very good at it!

chinese: 嗯，熟能生巧。吉姆，你多久打一次？
english: Well, practice makes perfect. How often do you play, Jim?

chinese: 我很少打乒乓球，但我经常打羽毛球。
english: I seldom do, but I often play badminton.

chinese: 我有时和埃拉一起打羽毛球。我们改天可以一起打双打！
english: I sometimes play badminton with Ella. We should all play doubles sometime!
